findings.title: Manifest pruning can delete files outside the checkout
findings.description: `InstallManifest.finish()` builds stale paths from the old manifest and then joins them to `targetRoot` and deletes them at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/manifest.ts:177-192` without `..`, absolute-path, or resolved-parent containment checks. The new worktree loop in `packages/cli/src/commands/setup-ide.ts:179-193` calls `installCheckout()` for every registered worktree, so this writer is now the only prune path for all checkouts. A hand-edited or corrupt `.context-forge/<target>.manifest` entry such as `1 1 ../important.txt` can escape `targetRoot`; `isFile()` follows symlinks, and `removeEmptyInstallDirs()` can also remove outside empty directories. The deleted `packages/cli/tests/commands/worktreePrune.test.ts` pinned traversal and symlink containment cases, but the remaining `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/manifest.test.ts` no longer covers them. Restore lexical plus realpath containment checks before deletion and add regression tests for traversal and symlink manifest entries.

findings.title: Dry run can write through symlinked install paths
findings.description: `copyInstallPaths()` copies top-level install paths with `verbatimSymlinks: true` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:37-45`, while the module states that the project is never touched at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:1-4`. `regularFilesUnder()` uses `lstatSync()` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/dryRun.ts:51-59`, so symlinked install files are excluded from the before/after report. During the sandbox install, `InstallManifest.installFile()` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/manifest.ts:133-140` and lint writes at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/lint.ts:74-80` use `writeFileSync()` on paths whose symlinks were preserved. If `.claude/rules/foo.md` or a lint write path is an absolute symlink, a dry run can write through the symlink to the real file outside the sandbox. Handle symlinks explicitly—skip, dereference into the sandbox, or reject them—and add a dry-run regression test using a symlinked install path.

findings.title: Native lint check breaks valid guide.exclude language removals
findings.description: `guide.exclude` explicitly allows removing individual language lint subtrees (`packages/core/src/config/ConfigKeys.ts:46`, `packages/core/src/config/guideExclude.ts:23-24`), but `checkLintConfigs()` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/lint.ts:224-237` only checks that the parent `lint` directory exists and skips a language only when `rules.exclude` contains `<lang>.md`. The language checks still read `<guide.lint>/<lang>/required` through `source()` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/lint.ts:60-63` and `missingRequirements()` at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/lint.ts:46-52`. A tarball guide that excludes `project-guides/lint/python` while leaving `python.md` installed therefore aborts a Python project’s setup with ENOENT; `installIde()` converts filesystem errors to exit 1 at `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/installer.ts:91-96`. The new `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/lint.test.ts` and `packages/cli/tests/ideInstall/rulesExclude.test.ts` cover `rules.exclude` but not this `guide.exclude`/`rules.exclude` combination. Skip missing language lint sources or fail with a user-facing config error, and add a regression test.

findings.title: rules.exclude is parsed without validating on read
findings.description: `readRulesExclude()` at `packages/cli/src/commands/setup-ide.ts:75-80` trusts `ConfigManager.get()` and then calls `parseRulesExclude()`. `ConfigManager.get()` at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigManager.ts:121-168` returns the raw stored value; validation is only invoked by `set()` at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigManager.ts:180-193`. The key validator rejects whitespace and empty entries at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigKeys.ts:164-185`, but `parseRulesExclude()` explicitly does neither at `packages/core/src/config/ConfigKeys.ts:190-194`. A legacy or hand-edited `.context-forge.toml` containing `dart.md, swift*.md` therefore becomes `['dart.md', ' swift*.md']`; `packages/cli/src/ideInstall/exclusions.ts#RuleExclusions` matches patterns literally and silently reports an unmatched pattern instead of failing explicitly, contrary to the project convention. `packages/core/tests/config/ConfigKeys.test.ts:21-60` only exercises direct validation calls, not a stored invalid value read through `ConfigManager`. Validate on read or parse defensively, and add a regression test using a real stored config value.

structured_findings.summary: Manifest pruning can delete files outside the checkout
Dry run can write through symlinked install paths
Native lint check breaks valid guide.exclude language removals
rules.exclude is parsed without validating on read
